skill.name: docs-architect
skill.description: Creates long-form technical documentation from codebases by analyzing architecture, design patterns, components, data flows, and implementation details.
skill.summary: Creates long-form architecture documentation from existing codebases.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: The only static finding is a false positive caused by Markdown inline code around a resource path in SKILL.md. No prompt injection, exfiltration intent, or executable code was found in the reviewed file.

static_findings.snippet: - If detailed examples are required, open `resources/implementation-playbook.md`.

finding_verdicts.reason: Line 26 contains a Markdown inline path reference, not Ruby or shell backtick execution. It instructs the agent to open a documentation resource and contains no command execution syntax.

content.value_statement: Teams need durable architecture documentation, but codebases change faster than manuals. This skill helps analyze structure, decisions, flows, and risks to draft maintainable technical references.
actual_capabilities: Maps code structure, dependencies, components, and relationships.
Plans chapter hierarchies for long technical manuals.
Drafts executive summaries, architecture overviews, and component deep dives.
Documents data models, integration points, deployment architecture, and security models.
Produces Markdown with headings, tables, code blocks, notes, and file references.
limitations: It depends on accessible project files and user-provided goals.
It does not verify runtime behavior without separate tests or execution.
It may reference a resources playbook that is not present in this package.
Reviewers must confirm architecture and security claims before publication.

use_cases.title: Onboard Engineering Teams
use_cases.description: Create a structured guide that explains system boundaries, key modules, dependencies, and reading paths for new developers.

use_cases.title: Prepare Architecture Reviews
use_cases.description: Draft review material that connects design decisions, component relationships, data flows, and operational tradeoffs.

use_cases.title: Create Maintenance Manuals
use_cases.description: Turn implementation details into long-form references for support, operations, and future feature work.

prompt_templates.title: Document a Service
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this repository and draft a Markdown architecture overview. Include system boundaries, major components, dependencies, and a short glossary.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Manual
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a chapter plan for comprehensive documentation. Include audience paths for developers, architects, and operations staff.

prompt_templates.title: Explain Design Decisions
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the main modules and document important design decisions. Explain the rationale, tradeoffs, risks, and verification points.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Documentation Set
prompt_templates.prompt: Produce a full technical manual outline with section drafts. Cover architecture, components, data models, integrations, deployment, performance, security, and appendices.

output_examples.input: A team asks for onboarding documentation for an existing service.
output_examples.output: The skill produces an executive summary, component map, dependency overview, glossary, and suggested reading path for new developers.

output_examples.input: An architect needs review material for a system redesign.
output: Design decision section with rationale and tradeoffs.
Integration and data flow sections for review.

output_examples.input: Operations needs a maintenance reference for a production system.
output_examples.output: The skill drafts deployment architecture, integration points, performance notes, security model details, and troubleshooting sections.

best_practices: Share repository scope, target audience, and required depth before generation.
Ask for file references so reviewers can verify technical claims.
Review security, deployment, and performance sections with domain owners.
anti_patterns: Requesting a full manual without giving the target audience.
Publishing generated architecture claims without checking them against current code.
Using the skill for unrelated writing tasks that do not need codebase analysis.

faq.question: What does this skill create?
faq.answer: It creates structured technical documentation for software systems, including architecture overviews, component descriptions, and design rationale.

faq.question: Does it read my whole repository?
faq.answer: It can analyze accessible files when the agent is permitted to inspect them.

faq.question: Can it create diagrams?
faq.answer: It describes diagrams and flowcharts in Markdown so teams can convert them into visual assets.

faq.question: Is it safe for private code?
faq.answer: Use it only in environments approved for the repository. Review generated content before sharing externally.

faq.question: Can it replace technical reviewers?
faq.answer: No. It drafts structured documentation, while engineers must confirm accuracy and missing context.

faq.question: Which tools can use it?
faq.answer: It is packaged for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows.
